text: player
The Fog
Some time earlier.
An unusual air hangs over One Han City.
Something strange is happening.
Leia
{var:player_nickname}, Miss Ichihime, I trust you've noticed it as well.
An unexplained fog is creeping in from the coast, threatening to engulf the city.
Kaavi
...According to my divinations, it will only spread further.
If this continues, not just the harbor, but all of One Han City will be brought to a complete standstill.
Ichihime
S-standstill?! Is it really that bad, nyaa?
Indeed. Neither transport nor production can operate normally with visibility this poor.
Isn't... isn't there any way to blow it away?
We can't just sit back and watch everything grind to a halt!
True, though it's beyond what the few of us can manage alone.
But Mahjong Soul Shrine, which can grant any wish, is a different matter.
Yuzu
Argh... The Witch of Justice needs the help of the Priestess of Justice!
All eyes fall upon Ichihime.
Nyaa?!
Ichihime, time to show us what a real priestess can do!
Pray to the Shrine for guidance to part this fog!
Master, are you placing the fate of One Han City squarely on my shoulders, nyaa?
Well, you are Ichihime the Hero, after all.
Nyavengers, to the rescue!
Braving the encroaching fog, Ichihime begins the ritual.
Nyaa-bra-cadabra…
Thick fog go away, clear skies come to stay, nyaa!
Nyaa?! The connection finally went through, nyaa!
One, two, three, four... Four external presences answered, nyaa!
Oh? Magic I've never seen before.
Hm... Must be this fog. Something's wrong with my spells.
Judging by your attire, you aren't like anyone I've met either, though you don't seem to be demons... Where exactly am I...?
Demons? What's that? Everyone here is human, nyaa.
I'm {var:player_nickname}. And these are Ichihime, Leia, Kaavi, and Yuzu.
Frieren
I'm Frieren. A mage.
This place seems quite different from where I came from. Could you explain what's going on here in detail?
So, that's pretty much the gist of it, nyaa!
I see.
Could it be a spell that connects different worlds that brought me here?
And what kind of magic resides within this Mahjong Soul Shrine of yours? How, exactly, does it grant wishes?
...It surely warrants further study.
Frieren seems lost in deep thought over the magic.
I don't really get how F-Fri... Frie's magic works, but isn't it kind of strange, nyaa?
Four presences answered back then, nyaa...
Yes. It seems the guidance from Mahjong Soul Shrine points to four individuals, including Ms. Frieren.
A concrete solution to this fog will likely require locating the other three as well...
My Red Panda Squad and I can communicate through magic no matter how far apart we are!
You must know a spell like that too, right, Ms. Frieren?
...It's not working well. Is this fog interfering with mana? None of the spells I know seem to cast properly.
But if it's just a rough location, that should suffice.
Over there.
An... island?
Nyaa?! There was nothing there a moment ago – when did that island pop up, nyaa?
There was definitely never an island in the waters near One Han City before.
Whatever the cause, everyone is completely taken by surprise.
Things are getting more complicated by the minute...
Let's head to the island.
I can sense the presence of two companions from my world over there.
And another... I don't know who it is, but the presence feels somewhat familiar.
We need to find them.
Exactly, nyaa!
They were summoned here to help us, so we can't just leave them stranded, nyaa.
Once we dispel this fog and get Mahjong Soul Shrine and One Han City back to normal, everything will be just fine, nyaa! And our guests from another world can go back home too, nyaa!
Ichihime brims with confidence.
Still, her instincts in matters like these are usually spot on.
Ichihime the Hero, savior of the world, setting off, nyaa!
Ichihime... is a hero?
Eh? What about it, nyaa?
My courage is 100% genuine, nyaa! Ask Master if you don't believe me!
I see. Looks like I've found reliable companions this time as well. How wonderful.
...Well then, let's head for that island.
We explain the entire situation to Frieren, the mage from another world, as well as the existence of the wish-granting Mahjong Soul Shrine.
You're right... I'll channel the spirit of drawing the Hero's Sword and take on whatever Demon King is behind this, nyaa!
